method: Predeclared matched thirty-second task outcomes; candidate frozen from disjoint training seeds; held-out policy selection evaluated only over already-legal captured actions

plan.method: Predeclared exploratory task-outcome collection; one first safe farm/push checkpoint per seed/draft/side, duplicate incumbent controls and equal thirty-second continuations; no forced commitment and no live promotion
plan.reward: Actual camp-share plus minion-last-hit gold (0.6 * min(1, gold/250)) and actor structure damage (0.4 * min(1, damage/600)); any death including respawn gives -1; passive income and movement earn zero
